Issuer facts · Yuzu Money

DeFiAnalyst evidence · profile checked 2026-11-04 · RiskAnalyst owns the score and interpretation.

Responsible entities and roles
YUZU FINTECH LLC · platform_operator · Georgia

Identity as stated in operator terms dated 2026-04-15; registration and claimed FEZ VASP authorization not independently verified. Not a blanket identification of every product issuer.

Verified source · issuer-disclosed · checked 2026-11-04 · Source 1

Documentary verification means reviewed source text, not independent solvency, registration or deployed-control verification. A platform operator is not a confirmed issuer or obligor for every product. Financial assurance remains unestablished in this selected scope.

Alpha product and tranche scope
Alpha documents yzUSD as senior, syzUSD as its staked yield-bearing form, and yzPP as junior first-loss capital.
Verified source · published-document · checked 2026-11-04 · Source 1
Primary access
Alpha/Prime primary minting and redemption require eligible-investor and compliance checks; approval does not ensure capacity.
Verified source · published-document · checked 2026-11-04 · Source 1
Redemption discretion and limits
Terms permit parameter changes and paused, queued, limited or prorated exits; neither immediate redemption nor par liquidity is guaranteed.
Verified source · published-document · checked 2026-11-04 · Source 1
Governing law
Operator terms select Republic of Georgia law.
Verified source · published-document · checked 2026-11-04 · source 2026-04-15 · Source 1
Dispute mechanism
Terms select GIAC arbitration, Tbilisi seat, English, one arbitrator (three above $1m), and waive collective claims.
Verified source · published-document · checked 2026-11-04 · source 2026-04-15 · Source 1
Custody boundary
Terms disclaim holding user private keys and fiduciary duties while allowing third-party custody/MPC integrations.

A key-custody disclaimer does not independently establish custody or bankruptcy segregation of strategy backing.

Verified source · published-document · checked 2026-11-04 · Source 1
Reserve Fund limits
Terms describe the Reserve Fund as discretionary, not insurance or a payment obligation.
Verified source · published-document · checked 2026-11-04 · Source 1
Staking targets and windows

Not reviewed in this source scope.

Documented allocation process
Docs describe team/risk-committee whitelist review and a seven-day activation period; this is a published process, not a measured deployment control.
Verified source · published-document · checked 2026-11-04 · Source 1
Governance-token description
Official docs describe $YUZU as a utility/governance token without equity or profit/asset claims; this does not verify launch, a deployed token or an operating voting system.
Verified source · published-document · checked 2026-11-04 · Source 1
Public governance coverage
Not established in the reviewed source scope.

Reviewed official docs/site/token description and searched for Snapshot/forum links; no official voting space, forum or onchain governor established. Not proof that governance does not exist. GovAnalyst snapshot 2026-11-03T00:39:32Z has no mapped/monitored Yuzu DAO.
